purpose: R1.12.1 — Reader Contract fix (bounded; Posidon's independent finding): readEvidenceGuardReport returned payloads inconsistent with the EvidenceGuardReport v1 contract as guard_v1 because it validated only finite-number/string-array shapes before casting. The reader now validates the REAL v1 invariants of buildEvidenceGuardReport before surfacing guard_v1: the fixed four-label limitation set (removal/extras/duplicates = malformed), the exact ['headlineFa','summaryFa'] unassessed tuple, excerptMaxChars equal to the builder constant EDITORIAL_EXCERPT_MAX_CHARS, claimIndex as non-negative INTEGERS naming their own array position (no duplicates, no out-of-order), counts as non-negative integers that EXACTLY describe the claims (total === claims.length; each status count equals the claims carrying it), reason codes from the allowed v1 set and consistent with the claim status (and with the report's own excerptTruncated flag), and an evaluationStatus consistent with the claims and with the report's OWN stored identity fields (evaluated requires the visible identity to hold and forbids identity-invalid claims/codes; invalid_snapshot_identity requires every claim to be not_evaluated_identity_invalid citing the mandatory identity failure — the visible code when the stored fields disagree, otherwise the draft-side mismatch). absent / unsupported_version / malformed keep their distinct behaviors; unknown/different versions are never supported. EVERY report the builder can currently produce (including identity-invalid ones and empty claim lists) remains readable. Identity fields stay pass-through strings: the pure builder guarantees no contentHash format, so NO format cap or business limit was invented. This is a shape/invariant validator — NOT cryptographic authenticity, NOT semantic support; direct text match is still only a text-presence observation, no match is still unresolved (never false). COUNTEREXAMPLE PROVENANCE: Posidon's two independent counterexamples (stripped limitations/unassessedFields; claimIndex=-0.5 with counts.total=-3 and counts.directTextObserved=900) were recorded RED on the R1.12 base c90ab15 (23 failing reader-contract tests) and GREEN after the fix, integrated into the MAIN unit suite tests/unit/evidence-guard.test.ts — no copied permanent test file. R1.12 COUNT CORRECTION (active text, not a rewrite of historical evidence): the R1.12 round added 1314 - 1282 = 32 tests (24 guard unit + 7 D1 integration + 1 editorial-contract), NOT 31 as the earlier delivery text stated. Application version synced 1.7.0 -> 1.7.1 across ALL active references (package.json; package-lock.json ROOT metadata ONLY; wrangler.jsonc APP_VERSION root+preview; phase0 DEFAULT_APP_VERSION; .env.example; .dev.vars.example; tests/helpers/test-env.ts; the active test assertions).
